description: `[T]` after a function, class or alias name (PEP 695, Python 3.12); its `TypeVar`s are stored in `__type_params__`.
`T: Base` accepts `Base` or any subtype of it, including a union when the bound is a union; stored in `__bound__`.
`T: (int, str)` means exactly one of the listed types; stored in `__constraints__`.
`type Pair[T] = tuple[T, T]` creates a lazy `TypeAliasType`; its `__value__` is evaluated on first access.
`class Page[T, Cursor = int]` (PEP 696, Python 3.13): `Page[str]` means `Page[str, int]`.
